items.name: Finset.sum_range_id
items.type: (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i = n * (n - 1) / 2

items.name: Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two
items.type: (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i) * 2 = n * (n - 1)

items.name: Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk
items.type: {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ × ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) : ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, f ij = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n.succ, f (k, n - k)

items.name: Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
items.type: {M : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) : ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, f ij.1 ij.2 = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n.succ, f k (n - k)

items.name: Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [Fintype α] {x : R} {v : α → R} : x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range v) ↔ ∃ c, ∑ i, c i * v i = x

items.name: AddSubmonoid.exists_of_mem_closure_range
items.type: {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] {ι : Type u_2} (f : ι → M) (x : M) [Fintype ι] (hx : x ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range f)) : ∃ a, x = ∑ i, a i • f i

items.name: AddSubmonoid.mem_closure_range_iff_of_fintype
items.type: {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] {ι : Type u_2} {f : ι → M} {x : M} [Fintype ι] : x ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range f) ↔ ∃ a, x = ∑ i, a i • f i
